Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V.SRISHANANDA)

Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed the memo which reads as under:
"The petitioner submits that C.C.7/2019 disposed off on 02.08.2025 and the petitioner is acquitted.
Hence the above petition has become infructuous.
Wherefore, the petitioner prays that, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to dismiss the above petition as infructuous, in the interest of justice."
Placing the memo on record, petition is dismissed as it has rendered infructuous.
